text: Offer Atlas moved to its own home at offeratlas.github.io, with data updated automatically every morning at 8 AM Toronto time.
Redesigned receipts: compact layout, application timeline, comparison chart and previous/next browsing.
Faster first load: Fall 2027 loads first, with a header toggle to switch to all years.
Shareable links for every filter view and every receipt.
Latest reports ticker, average slider, shorter filter panel and a phone-friendly layout.
290 program pages and 24 school pages with year-by-year trends and what applicants mentioned.
New tools: Compare my average, Offer tracker, watchlist, share-as-image and flag-a-report.
Dark mode that follows your device, with a manual switch.
Credit to u/Regular-Database9310, creator of the r/OntarioGrade12s spreadsheets, plus clearer self-reported disclaimers.
New: When will I hear back? estimator, site-wide search (Ctrl+K), admissions guides, similar programs, follow-a-program feeds, weekly recap images and this changelog.
Added anonymous, cookie-free visit counting (GoatCounter). No personal data is collected; see Sources & credits.
Search understands nicknames like “UW CS”, “Mac Health Sci”, “Ivey AEO” and “Queens Comm”.
Cleaner program names: about 250 more reports now join their official program, and names applicants commonly write the same way are grouped and labelled “Name as reported”.
Compare accepts decimal averages like 97.33 on every phone and browser.
